results.title: Vague, unnamed monitoring tech for a pharma-heavy fleet with dedicated vaccine trucks
results.closest_fact_claim: The company operates 202 vehicles (Ashok Leyland and Tata Motors chassis), including 20 newly developed reefer trucks specifically for safe handling of pharmaceutical products, especially vaccines.

results.title: Aggressive 5-year growth plan risks outpacing monitoring infrastructure
results.closest_fact_claim: Coldrush plans to add another 150-200 trucks to reach 100,000 pallets of capacity within five years, and to open cold storages and branch offices in the capital city of each north-eastern 'seven sisters' state within 3-5 years.
